answer: In an agent market for terrace plans, meadow surveys, and pearl appraisals, dispute votes are weighted by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, rather than by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents gives the same total voting weight as one agent holding 100. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, tying up capital and forgoing its use elsewhere for the full lock period.
